name: idea-to-prototype
description: Turn a rough product idea into an anti-generic prototype package by applying supplied design/source files or generating a source baseline when none exists.

interface.shortDescription: Apply source if present; generate it if missing.
interface.longDescription: A local Codex plugin for turning rough product ideas into bounded prototype packages. It applies supplied design/source materials when available, generates a reusable source baseline when not available, then creates source inventory, anti-generic gate, opportunity memo, screen map, prototype brief, design contract, build spec, clickable scaffold, and verification report.
defaultPrompt: Turn this idea into an anti-generic prototype plan.
Use this design.md and source folder to create a source-applied prototype.
No source files yet; generate the source baseline and build the prototype.
Apply this screen spec and brand guide before building the prototype.
Create a prototype brief and build spec before coding.
Scaffold a clickable working prototype and write verification notes.
